name: campus-sanitation-system
description: Bennett University Campus Sanitation Rating System

scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently "cd backend && npm run dev" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run init-db && npm run seed && npm run build
scripts.deploy: npm run build && NODE_ENV=production npm start
